title: Jazz and Popular Music 2
description: Revise Jazz and Popular Music concepts introduced up to National 4, including styles, instruments, effects and musical devices.

items.prompt: An unplugged guitar usually has six strings and a hollow body that naturally projects their sound. Name this type of guitar.
A collection of drums and cymbals played by one performer using sticks, brushes and foot pedals.
Name the usual six-string, guitar-register instrument whose pickups send the string sound to an amplifier.
As a keyboard instrument, pressing a key causes a felt-covered hammer to strike a string.
An early piano style with a syncopated melody against a steady left-hand bass-note-and-chord accompaniment.
Rhyming words delivered as rhythmic speech, characteristically over a hip-hop beat. Name the vocal style.
Name the danceable big-band jazz style especially associated with the 1930s and 1940s, uneven quaver pairs, and brass-and-saxophone riffs.
Give the two-word term for improvised jazz singing using nonsense syllables.
A repeated accompaniment pattern, often alternating a bass note on the beat with a chord off the beat.
